subject: MidRidge discovery: fit summary, eval artifacts, and temporary pin request
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@midridge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@midridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Great meeting — recap, recommended models & next steps

Hi Daniel / Priya,

Thanks for the time today — great discussion on the customer service use case and the 1.5M monthly message volume. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Primary goal: Automated triage + suggested responses for Tier 1 agents, 120ms median latency target for single-turn generation, and strong hallucination controls.
- Top risks you flagged: factual hallucinations on invoice-text extracts and sensitivity around PII handling.
- Recommended starting candidates (based on today's example prompts): redwood-inc/mod-7b-q4 (fast, cheaper) and redwood-inc/mod-13b-ssl (higher-quality for longer context).

Action items we committed to: 
1) Share an eval pack (prompts + example transcripts + scoring rubric).
2) Provide a short benchmark (latency/cost) for the two model candidates using your sample dataset.
3) Outline a conservative rollout plan including pinning and automatic fallback if we detect quality regressions.

Attachments/links: I uploaded the eval prompts and a lightweight runner to Drive (link below). Also including a CSV with initial microbenchmarks for similar customers.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XxMidRidgeEvalPack

Let me know if you want the eval pack split by intent, or if there are other internal privacy constraints we should account for before we run tests.

I'll loop in Marissa for the technical follow-up and Rishi for regression controls.

Best,
Dylan

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[d] +1 (415) 555-0143
attachments: midridge_eval_prompts.zip (archive), midridge_bench_results.csv (csv)

From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@midridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@midridge.com>, procurement@midridge.com
Date: 2027-09-30T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Great meeting — recap, recommended models & next steps

Thanks Dylan — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications before we run the pack: 

- Can you confirm the default data retention policy during a trial? We need logs for debugging but want a 30-day retention max.
- If we see a quality delta once you upgrade model versions in your catalog, what is the rollback path? Do you support pinning a customer to a model version?

We'll review the eval pack this week and circle back with a preferred test subset by Friday. Procurement (cc'd) will need the MPA draft for legal review.

Thanks,
Daniel

--
Daniel Kim
Head of Product, MidRidge
D: +1 (415) 555-9987

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-01T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MidRidge discovery: fit summary, eval artifacts, and temporary pin request

Dylan — looping Rishi and Monica for technical and compliance input before we send a formal plan back to MidRidge. Notes: 

- Retention: We can run the trial with 30-day retention in hosted mode; we'll record only telemetry and sanitized logs unless they request raw payloads. Monica: can you confirm the KMS/HSM options for their evaluation?
- Pinning and rollback: Rishi, do we have a standard emergency pin flow we can offer? Prefer to give them a concrete SLA for reversion if model update causes regressions.

Proposed customer-facing language: we offer a temporary pin to a specific model build for the duration of the POC (30 days) with an automated rollback trigger if evaluation metrics (F1 on intent + hallucination rate) degrade beyond agreed thresholds. We may need an exception to default auto-upgrade policy.

Marissa

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-01T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MidRidge discovery: fit summary, eval artifacts, and temporary pin request

Marissa / Dylan — quick technical confirmation and suggested wording for the customer: 

- Yes, we support per-customer model pinning to a model build-id (example: mod-13b-ssl@20270901). Pinning disables auto-upgrades and routes traffic to the pinned runtime.
- Rollback: we can initiate a rollback to the previous pinned build within 15 minutes; for hosted customers, rollback is automatic when an operator triggers it — we also support an API-based rollback if they want programmatic control.
- Emergency flow: if the customer's evaluation detects a +8% drop in intent F1 or a >2x spike in hallucination rate compared to baseline, we'll auto-open an ops incident and revert to the last pinned build while we triage. We should ask MidRidge to mark the baseline evaluation run in their eval pack so thresholds are stable.

I'll prepare a short ops playbook (checklist + contact points) and attach it.

-Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Model Reliability

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@midridge.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@midridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@midridge.com
Date: 2027-10-02T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Eval pack, benchmarks, and temporary pin + rollback plan (MPA attached)

Hi Daniel / Priya — thanks again. Quick deliverables and proposed POC guardrails below: 

1) Eval pack (attached): midridge_eval_prompts.zip — includes 300 labeled examples, split by intent (billing, returns, shipping, other).
2) Benchmarks: initial microbench results attached (midridge_bench_results.csv). For your sample, mod-7b-q4 median latency is ~95ms; mod-13b-ssl median latency is ~210ms. Estimated token cost per 1k requests provided in the CSV.
3) Retention: we will set a 30-day retention on logs for the POC and only store sanitized payloads. KMS-backed key available on request.
4) Pin & rollback: we propose to pin you to mod-13b-ssl@20270901 for the POC. If the customer-run eval (baseline run noted in the eval pack) shows >8% F1 drop on intents or >2x hallucination rate vs baseline, Redwood will automatically revert to the previous pinned build and open an incident. This will be documented in the MPA clause; legal (procurement cc'd) can review.

Next steps: 
- Please confirm acceptance of the POC guardrails and MPA draft (attached signed_mpa_draft.pdf).
- Priya / Daniel, if you want a more conservative approach we can start with mod-7b-q4 for a small subset of intents and expand to mod-13b-ssl later.

If accepted, Marissa will schedule the onboarding handoff with our Solutions + ML ops teams and Rishi will ship the ops playbook.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
[d] +1 (415) 555-0143
attachments: signed_mpa_draft.pdf (pdf)
